purpose: Propuestas visuales de SUPERKANES. Imágenes conceptuales con datos ficticios; no implican cambios funcionales ni aplicación del diseño al frontend.

generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, highly realistic desktop web application design concept for SUPERKANES, a veterinary clinic management product. Flat straight-on screenshot, landscape 16:10, high resolution, sharp readable Spanish typography. Show one full application screen, not a collage, no device frame, no perspective, no browser chrome, no presentation decorations. Contemporary enterprise product design quality: refined typography similar to Inter, clear hierarchy, precise spacing, subtle one-pixel dividers, restrained rounded corners, minimal shadows, accessible contrast, practical compact controls. Brand: small abstract botanical/paw symbol and lowercase wordmark "superkanes." White and warm off-white canvas, deep forest green primary actions, muted sage selection backgrounds, dark charcoal text, subtle blue informational details. Consistent 200px pale sidebar with organization selector "Clínica Norte", navigation "Resumen", "Agenda", "Pacientes", "Historia clínica", "Laboratorio", "Documentos", "Configuración", and small user profile at bottom "Dra. Valentina". Top bar with breadcrumbs, wide command search "Buscar paciente, tutor o documento", notification icon and avatar. Use fictional demonstration information only. No references to MinIO, JSON, code, implementation, AI assistant, other brands, or watermarks. This should look like an excellent usable software product, with generous breathing room but useful clinical content. Screen 1: clinic overview. Active sidebar "Resumen". Main heading "Tu clínica, en orden." Subheading "Martes, 10 de noviembre · Un buen día para cuidar". Top right primary "Nueva consulta" and secondary "Ver agenda". Under heading, a refined horizontal strip with four compact metrics separated by hairlines: "Citas de hoy" 18, "En consulta" 3, "Por llegar" 5, "Resultados pendientes" 4. Main content is an elegant large today's schedule occupying two thirds width, titled "La jornada de hoy" with date control and view toggle, organized rows with time, small patient portrait, patient name/species, tutor, type and status. Entries: "09:00 Nala · Canino · Ana Torres · Control · En consulta", "09:30 Milo · Felino · Carlos Ruiz · Vacunación · En espera", "10:00 Bruno · Canino · Sofía López · Primera consulta · Confirmada", "10:30 Luna · Felino · Mateo Díaz · Seguimiento · Por llegar". Each row has restrained colored status pill and chevron. Right third a vertically arranged "Tu siguiente paciente" featured panel with tasteful close-up photo of a friendly golden retriever, "Nala", "Control general", "Ana Torres", button "Abrir ficha"; below a small "Pendientes del equipo" task list with 3 actionable items "Revisar hemograma de Milo", "Confirmar control de Bruno", "Enviar indicaciones de Luna". Bottom a simple slim recent activity list with tiny monochrome icons, not excessive charts. Design focus: calm sophisticated operational overview, attractive professional animal imagery used sparingly.

finalBlueEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, UI mockup recolor. Edit this SUPERKANES veterinary application screen into an elegant BLUE design system. Preserve the complete layout, dimensions, typography, every Spanish text, icons, fictional people and animal photos, clinical values and all UI elements. Replace the forest green brand logo, headings, active navigation text, active underlines, selected view controls and primary buttons with deep navy #123B72 and refined royal blue #2563EB. Replace pale green/sage selection backgrounds and green decorative surfaces with very light ice blue #EAF2FF. Main background white #FFFFFF and very pale blue-gray #F7F9FC, text deep slate #172B4D. Make primary button labels white. Use blue-tinted small icon backgrounds and blue status accents instead of green. Keep clinically meaningful amber warning badges amber. Do not recolor photographs or skin or animals. Preserve legibility and premium big-tech product polish. No other new content, no layout changes, no green UI styling, no collage, no watermark.
